data.name: Madness Bomb
data.description: The alchemist's bombs do more than sear flesh - they sear the mind. A creature that takes a direct hit from a madness bomb takes damage from the bomb plus 1d4 points of Wisdom damage. Reduce the amount of normal damage dealt by the bomb by 2d%1 (so a bomb that would normally deal 6d%1+4 points of damage deals 4d%1+4 points of damage instead). The amount of Wisdom damage dealt by a madness bomb is reduced by 1 for each madness bomb that hit the target in the past 24 hours, to a minimum of 1 point of Wisdom damage.|AlchemistBombDiceSize
